about: Layout 3b, the build target of ADR-0010 (2026-10-17): the solver's case 3 (PSU flat, exits free) with the field rail shifted to x 40-324 and two upper-left grommets, so every cable group has a duct path. Centres in mm (x front 0 to back 457, y left 0 to right 330); rot 1 = the block's long side runs along y. Score with layout_study.Score('B', place) after setting Exits to 'exits' and renaming the SHIELD-UL net to SHIELD-ULM. Expected wire: 34892 conductor-mm (hand layout 57478).
